themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 8 complaints THIS WEEK compared to a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 6,300% increase (z-score: 23.81)—suggesting a coordinated posting campaign or enforcement gap in Midwood/Ocean Parkway.
evidence: 8 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (6,300% spike)
Z-score of 23.81 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Spike emerged suddenly with no gradual escalation pattern
reporting_angles: Canvas the neighborhood to document what is being illegally posted (political ads, business promotions, scams) and where hotspots are concentrated
Interview Sanitation Department about enforcement capacity and whether this reflects a known campaign or systemic removal delays

themes_detail.label: Construction Activity Surge
themes_detail.summary: General construction/plumbing complaints jumped to 36 THIS WEEK from a baseline of 13.2 per week (172% increase, z-score: 5.61), coinciding with 313 total DOB building permits filed in the last 90 days (234 alteration filings), suggesting either coordinated construction projects or inadequate project management/notification.
evidence: 36 construction/plumbing complaints THIS WEEK vs. 13.2 weekly baseline (172% spike)
313 DOB permits filed in last 90 days, with 234 alteration filings, indicating sustained construction activity
reporting_angles: Map complaint hotspots against active DOB permits to identify which projects are generating the most complaints (noise, obstruction, dust)
Interview residents in high-complaint blocks about construction schedules, noise hours, and whether contractors are notifying affected neighbors

themes_detail.label: Obstruction & Lot Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints jumped to 14 LAST WEEK from a 4.4 weekly baseline (220% increase, z-score: 8.66), while lot condition (3 complaints) and dumpster complaints (3 complaints) each spiked 2,300% last week, indicating possible abandoned properties or inadequate property maintenance enforcement.
evidence: Obstruction complaints: 14 LAST WEEK vs. 4.4 weekly baseline (220% spike, z-score: 8.66)
Lot condition: 3 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2,300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Dumpster complaints: 3 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2,300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Cluster suggests spatial concentration rather than random events
reporting_angles: Identify which blocks or properties are generating multiple complaints across these three categories—likely indicating problem landlords or abandoned buildings
Request HPD violation history and tax delinquency records for properties with clustered complaints to build enforcement angle

themes_detail.label: Indoor Air Quality Concerns
themes_detail.summary: Indoor air quality complaints peaked 3 WEEKS AGO at 12 complaints (256% increase from 3.4 weekly baseline, z-score: 7.08), suggesting possible heating system failures, mold outbreaks, or construction dust infiltration affecting multiple buildings.
evidence: 12 indoor air quality complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 3.4 weekly baseline (256% spike, z-score: 7.08)
Timing aligns with seasonal heating activation (late fall/early winter period)
Heat/hot water complaints remain elevated at 5,499 over 90 days, suggesting systemic building HVAC/heating issues
reporting_angles: Interview HPD about which buildings generated multiple air quality complaints and what violations were issued; determine if pattern reflects building code compliance gaps
Report on mold/air quality in rent-regulated vs. market-rate buildings to assess whether landlord maintenance disparities exist

themes_detail.label: Sanitation & Pest Management Strain
themes_detail.summary: Sanitation worker/vehicle complaints spiked to 6 LAST WEEK (336% increase from 1.4 weekly baseline, z-score: 4.66), while unsanitary pigeon complaints peaked 3 WEEKS AGO at 3 (500% increase from 0.5 baseline), suggesting either collection service gaps or inadequate pest control coordination.
evidence: Sanitation worker/vehicle complaints: 6 LAST WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly baseline (336% spike, z-score: 4.66)
Unsanitary pigeon complaints: 3 complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (500% spike, z-score: 5.0)
Convergence of sanitation staffing and pest management issues suggests interconnected service delivery problem
reporting_angles: Contact Sanitation Department about missed pickups, vehicle breakdowns, or staffing shortages during this period
Investigate whether pigeon complaints correlate with food waste or litter accumulation from collection gaps
